translations.literal: " Favor, rewards, and gifts—no minister could match him.
translations.idiomatic: " In favor and reward, no minister could match him.

sentences.zh: 魏將王雄取上津、魏興，東梁州刺史安康李遷哲軍敗。

translations.literal: Wei general Wang Xiong took Shangjin and Weixing; Li Qianzhe of Ankang, Eastern Liangzhou Inspector, was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Wei general Wang Xiong took Shangjin and Weixing; Li Qianzhe of Ankang, Eastern Liangzhou inspector, was defeated.

sentences.zh: 降之。

translations.literal: He surrendered to him.
translations.idiomatic: Qianzhe surrendered.

sentences.zh: 突闕土門襲擊柔然，大破之。

translations.literal: Tujue's Tumen struck Rouran and routed them.
translations.idiomatic: Tumen of the Turks struck Rouran and routed them.

sentences.zh: 柔然頭兵可汗自殺，其太子庵羅辰及阿那瑰從弟登注俟利、登注子庫提並帥眾奔齊，餘眾復立登注次子鐵伐為主。

translations.literal: Rouran's Khan Toubing killed himself; his crown prince Anluochen and Anagui's younger cousin Dengzhu Sili and Dengzhu's son Kuti all led their followers to flee to Qi; the remainder again made Dengzhu's second son Tiefa their lord.
translations.idiomatic: Rouran's Khan Toubing killed himself; Crown Prince Anluochen, Anagui's younger cousin Dengzhu Sili, and Dengzhu's son Kuti all led their followers to Qi; the remainder again made Dengzhu's second son Tiefa their lord.

sentences.zh: 土門自號伊利可汗，號其妻為可賀敦，子弟謂之特勒，別將兵者皆謂之設。

translations.literal: Tumen styled himself Yili Khagan, called his wife Khehedun, termed his sons and younger brothers tejin, and termed all who separately commanded troops she.
translations.idiomatic: Tumen styled himself Yili Khagan, called his wife Khehedun, termed his sons and younger brothers tejin, and termed all who separately commanded troops she.

sentences.zh: 湘東王命王僧辯等東擊侯景。

translations.literal: The Prince of Xiangdong ordered Wang Sengbian and others east to strike Hou Jing.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Xiangdong ordered Wang Sengbian and others east against Hou Jing.

sentences.zh: 二月，庚子，諸軍發尋陽，舳艫數百里。

translations.literal: In the second month, on gengzi, the armies set out from Xunyang; the line of ships stretched for hundreds of li.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengzi, the armies set out from Xunyang; the line of ships stretched for hundreds of li.

sentences.zh: 陳霸先帥甲士三萬，舟艦二千，自南江出湓口，會僧辯於白茅灣，築壇歃血，共讀盟文，流涕慷慨。

translations.literal: Chen Baxian led thirty thousand armored men and two thousand vessels from the Southern River out through Pankou, met Sengbian at Baimao Bay, built an altar and smeared blood, together read the covenant text, and wept with fervor.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Baxian led thirty thousand armored men and two thousand vessels from the Southern River out through Pankou, met Sengbian at Baimao Bay, built an altar and smeared blood, read the covenant together, and wept with fervor.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，僧辯使侯瑱南陵、鵲頭二戍，克之。

translations.literal: On guimao, Sengbian sent Hou Tian against the garrisons of Nanling and Quetou and took them.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Sengbian sent Hou Tian against the garrisons of Nanling and Quetou and took them.

sentences.zh: 戊申，僧辯等軍於大雷；

translations.literal: On wushen, Sengbian and others encamped at Dalei.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Sengbian and others encamped at Dalei.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，發鵲頭。

translations.literal: On bingchen, they set out from Quetou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, they set out from Quetou.

sentences.zh: 戊午，侯子鑒還至戰鳥，西軍奄至，子鑒驚懼，奔還淮南。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Hou Zijian returned to Zhanniao; the western army came upon him suddenly; Zijian, alarmed and afraid, fled back to Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Hou Zijian returned to Zhanniao; the western army came upon him suddenly; terrified, Zijian fled back to Huainan.

sentences.zh: 侯景儀同三司謝答仁攻劉神茂於東陽，程靈洗、張彪皆勒兵將救之，神茂欲專其功，不許，營於下淮。

translations.literal: Hou Jing's Palace Attendant of the Third Rank Xie Daren attacked Liu Shenma at Dongyang; Cheng Lingxi and Zhang Biao both mustered troops to rescue him; Shenma wished to keep the merit for himself and would not allow it, and encamped at Xiahuai.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jing's Palace Attendant of the Third Rank Xie Daren attacked Liu Shenma at Dongyang; Cheng Lingxi and Zhang Biao both mustered troops to rescue him; Shenma wanted the credit alone and refused them, encamping at Xiahuai.

sentences.zh: 或謂神茂曰：「賊長於野戰，下淮地平，四面受敵，不如據七里瀨，賊必不能進。

translations.literal: Someone told Shenma, "The rebels excel at field battle; Xiahuai is level ground and exposed on every side—better hold Qililai; the rebels surely cannot advance.
translations.idiomatic: Someone told Shenma, "The rebels excel in open battle; Xiahuai is level and exposed on every side—better hold Qililai; they cannot advance there.

sentences.zh: 」不從。

translations.literal: " He would not heed this.
translations.idiomatic: " He would not listen.

sentences.zh: 神茂偏裨多北人，不與神茂同心，別將王曄、酈通並據外營，降於答仁，劉歸義、尹思合等棄城走。

translations.literal: Many of Shenma's subordinate commanders were northerners and did not share his heart; detached commanders Wang Ye and Li Tong both held the outer camp and surrendered to Daren; Liu Guiyi, Yin Sihe, and others abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Many of Shenma's subordinate commanders were northerners and did not share his heart; detached commanders Wang Ye and Li Tong held the outer camp and surrendered to Daren; Liu Guiyi, Yin Sihe, and others abandoned the city and fled.

sentences.zh: 神茂孤危，辛未，亦降於答仁，答仁送之建康。

translations.literal: Shenma, isolated and endangered, on xinwei also surrendered to Daren; Daren sent him to Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Isolated and desperate, Shenma on xinwei also surrendered to Daren, who sent him to Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，王僧辯等至蕪湖，侯景守將張黑棄城走。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Wang Sengbian and others reached Wuhu; Hou Jing's garrison commander Zhang Hei abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Wang Sengbian and others reached Wuhu; Hou Jing's garrison commander Zhang Hei abandoned the city and fled.

sentences.zh: 景聞之，甚懼，下詔赦湘東王繹、王僧辯之罪，眾鹹笑之。

translations.literal: Jing heard this and was greatly afraid; he issued an edict pardoning Prince Yi of Xiangdong and Wang Sengbian; all laughed.
translations.idiomatic: Jing heard and was greatly afraid; he issued an edict pardoning Prince Xiao Yi of Xiangdong and Wang Sengbian; everyone laughed.

sentences.zh: 侯子鑒據姑孰南洲以拒西師，景遣其黨史安和等將兵二千助之。

translations.literal: Hou Zijian held Gudu's southern isle to resist the western army; Jing sent his follower Shi Anhe and others with two thousand troops to assist him.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Zijian held Gudu's southern isle against the western army; Jing sent his follower Shi Anhe and others with two thousand men to help.

sentences.zh: 三月，己巳朔，景下詔欲自至姑孰，又遣人戒子鑒曰：「西人善水戰，勿與爭鋒；

translations.literal: In the third month, on the first day jisi, Jing issued an edict saying he wished to go to Gudu himself, and also sent men to warn Zijian, "The westerners excel at naval combat—do not contend with them at the sharp edge.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the first day jisi, Jing issued an edict that he would go to Gudu himself, and sent men to warn Zijian: "The westerners excel at naval combat—do not meet them on the water.

sentences.zh: 往年任約之敗，良為此也。

translations.literal: Ren Yue's defeat in former years was truly because of this.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Yue's defeat in former years was exactly because of this.

sentences.zh: 若得步騎一交，必當可破，汝但結營岸上，引船入浦以待之。

translations.literal: If you can get one clash of infantry and cavalry, they can surely be broken; you need only build camps on shore and draw the ships into creeks to await them.
translations.idiomatic: Give them one clash of infantry and cavalry and they can be broken; you need only build camps on shore and draw the ships into creeks to wait.

sentences.zh: 」子鑒乃捨舟登岸，閉營不出。

translations.literal: " Zijian then abandoned the boats and went ashore, shut his camps, and would not come out.
translations.idiomatic: " Zijian abandoned the boats, went ashore, shut his camps, and would not come out.

sentences.zh: 僧辯等停軍蕪湖十餘日，景黨大喜，告景曰：「西師畏吾之強，勢將遁矣，不擊，且失之。

translations.literal: Sengbian and others halted at Wuhu for more than ten days; Jing's followers were greatly pleased and told Jing, "The western army fears our strength and is about to flee—if we do not strike, we shall lose them.
translations.idiomatic: Sengbian halted at Wuhu for more than ten days; Jing's followers rejoiced and told him, "The western army fears our strength and is about to flee—if we do not strike, we lose them.

sentences.zh: 」景乃覆命子鑒為水戰之備。

translations.literal: " Jing then countermanded and ordered Zijian to prepare for naval battle.
translations.idiomatic: " Jing countermanded and ordered Zijian to prepare for naval battle.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，僧辯至姑孰，子鑒帥步騎萬餘人度洲，於岸挑戰，又以□鳥□了千艘載戰士。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Sengbian reached Gudu; Zijian led more than ten thousand infantry and cavalry across the isle and challenged from the bank, and also had □鳥□了 a thousand vessels carry warriors.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Sengbian reached Gudu; Zijian led more than ten thousand infantry and cavalry across the isle and challenged from the bank, and also had □鳥□了 a thousand vessels carry warriors.

sentences.zh: 僧辯麾細船皆令退縮，留大艦夾泊兩岸。

translations.literal: Sengbian ordered all light boats to withdraw, leaving great ships moored on both banks.
translations.idiomatic: Sengbian ordered the light boats to withdraw, leaving great ships moored on both banks.

sentences.zh: 子鑒之眾謂水軍欲退，爭出趨之；

translations.literal: Zijian's men thought the fleet meant to retreat and all rushed out to pursue.
translations.idiomatic: Zijian's men thought the fleet was retreating and rushed out in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 大艦斷其歸路，鼓噪大呼，合戰中江，子鑒大敗，士卒赴水死者數千人。

translations.literal: The great ships cut off their return; drums and shouts rose; battle joined mid-river; Zijian was utterly defeated and thousands of soldiers died in the water.
translations.idiomatic: The great ships cut off their return; drums and shouts rose; battle joined mid-river; Zijian was routed and thousands drowned.

sentences.zh: 子鑒僅以身免，收散卒走還建康，據東府。

translations.literal: Zijian barely escaped with his life, gathered scattered troops, fled back to Jiankang, and held the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Zijian barely escaped, gathered scattered troops, fled to Jiankang, and held the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 僧辯留虎臣將軍莊丘慧達鎮姑孰，引軍而前，歷陽戍迎降。

translations.literal: Sengbian left Tiger-Minister General Zhuangqiu Huida to garrison Gudu and led the army forward; the garrison of Liyang came out to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Sengbian left Tiger-Minister General Zhuangqiu Huida at Gudu and advanced; the garrison of Liyang surrendered.

sentences.zh: 景聞子鑒敗，大懼，涕下覆面，引衾而臥，良久方起，歎曰：「誤殺乃公！

translations.literal: Jing heard that Zijian was defeated and was greatly afraid; tears covered his face; he pulled the quilt over himself and lay down; only after a long while did he rise and sigh, "I killed the old man by mistake!
translations.idiomatic: Hearing of Zijian's defeat, Jing was terrified; tears covered his face; he pulled the quilt over himself and lay down; only after a long while did he rise and sigh, "I killed the old man by mistake!

sentences.zh: 庚辰，僧辯督諸軍至張公洲，辛巳，乘潮入淮，進至禪靈寺前。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Sengbian directed the armies to Zhanggong Isle; on xinsi, riding the tide they entered the Huai and advanced to before Chanling Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Sengbian brought the armies to Zhanggong Isle; on xinsi, riding the tide they entered the Huai and advanced to Chanling Temple.

sentences.zh: 景召石頭津主張賓，使引淮中□叉□步及海艟，以石縋之，塞淮口；

translations.literal: Jing summoned Zhang Bin, master of the Shitou ford, and had him bring □叉□步 from the Huai and sea warships, sink them with stones, and block the Huai mouth.
translations.idiomatic: Jing summoned Zhang Bin, master of the Shitou ford, had him bring □叉□步 from the Huai and sea warships, sink them with stones, and block the Huai mouth.

sentences.zh: 緣淮作城，自石頭至於朱雀街，十餘里中，樓堞相接。

translations.literal: Along the Huai he built a wall; from Shitou to Zhuque Street, for more than ten li, towers and battlements linked one to another.
translations.idiomatic: Along the Huai he built a wall from Shitou to Zhuque Street; for more than ten li, towers and battlements linked end to end.

sentences.zh: 僧辯問計於陳霸先，霸先曰：「前柳仲禮數十萬兵隔水而坐，韋粲在青溪，竟不度岸，賊登高望之，表裡俱盡，故能覆我師徒。

translations.literal: Sengbian asked Chen Baxian for counsel; Baxian said, "Before, Liu Zhongli with hundreds of thousands of men sat across the water, Wei Can was at Qingxi, and in the end they never crossed the bank; the rebels looked down from the heights and saw inside and out completely, and so could overturn our army.
translations.idiomatic: Sengbian asked Chen Baxian for counsel; Baxian said, "Before, Liu Zhongli sat across the water with hundreds of thousands of men, Wei Can was at Qingxi, and neither crossed the bank; the rebels looked down and saw everything inside and out, and overturned our army.

sentences.zh: 今圍石頭，須度北岸。

translations.literal: Now besieging Shitou, we must cross the north bank.
translations.idiomatic: Now, besieging Shitou, we must cross the north bank.

sentences.zh: 諸將若不能當鋒，霸先請先往立柵。

translations.literal: If the generals cannot meet the sharp edge, Baxian asks to go first and build palisades.
translations.idiomatic: If the generals cannot meet the charge, Baxian asks to go first and build palisades.

sentences.zh: 」壬午，霸先於石頭西落星山築柵，眾軍次連八城，直出石頭西北。

translations.literal: " On renwu, Baxian built palisades at Luoxing Mountain west of Shitou; the armies in succession linked eight forts and thrust straight out northwest of Shitou.
translations.idiomatic: " On renwu, Baxian built palisades at Luoxing Mountain west of Shitou; the armies linked eight forts in succession and thrust out northwest of Shitou.

sentences.zh: 景恐西州路絕，自帥侯子鑒等亦於石頭東北築五城以遏大路。

translations.literal: Jing, fearing the Xizhou road would be cut, himself led Hou Zijian and others to build five forts northeast of Shitou to block the great road.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing the Xizhou road would be cut, Jing himself led Hou Zijian and others to build five forts northeast of Shitou and block the great road.

sentences.zh: 景使王偉等守台城。

translations.literal: Jing sent Wang Wei and others to guard the palace city.
translations.idiomatic: Jing sent Wang Wei and others to guard the palace city.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，景殺湘東王世子方諸、前平東將軍杜幼安。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Jing killed Prince Yi of Xiangdong's heir Fangzhu and former General Who Pacifies the East Du You'an.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Jing killed Prince Xiao Yi's heir Fangzhu and former General Who Pacifies the East Du You'an.

sentences.zh: 劉神茂至建康，丙戌，景命為大坐刀碓，先進其足，寸寸斬之，以至於頭。

translations.literal: Liu Shenma reached Jiankang; on bingxu, Jing ordered the great seated blade and pestle; they advanced his feet first and chopped him inch by inch up to the head.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shenma reached Jiankang; on bingxu, Jing ordered the great seated blade and pestle; they fed in his feet first and chopped him inch by inch up to the head.

sentences.zh: 留異外同神茂而潛通於景，故得免禍。

translations.literal: Liu Yi outwardly joined Shenma but secretly communicated with Jing, and so escaped disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yi outwardly joined Shenma but secretly dealt with Jing, and so escaped punishment.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，王僧辯進軍招提寺北，侯景帥眾萬餘人、鐵騎八百餘匹陳於西州之西。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Wang Sengbian advanced north of Zhaoti Temple; Hou Jing led more than ten thousand men and more than eight hundred iron cavalry and formed battle lines west of Xizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Wang Sengbian advanced north of Zhaoti Temple; Hou Jing drew up more than ten thousand men and eight hundred iron cavalry west of Xizhou.

sentences.zh: 陳霸先曰：「我眾賊寡，應分其兵勢，以強制弱；

translations.literal: Chen Baxian said, "We are many and the rebels few—we should divide their military force and use strength to constrain weakness.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Baxian said, "We are many and they few—we should divide their force and use strength against weakness.

sentences.zh: 何故聚其鋒銳，令致死於我！

translations.literal: Why gather their sharp edge and make them fight to the death against us!
translations.idiomatic: Why gather their best troops and make them fight to the death against us!

sentences.zh: 」乃命諸將分處置兵。

translations.literal: " He then ordered the generals to deploy troops in separate positions.
translations.idiomatic: " He then ordered the generals to deploy in separate positions.

sentences.zh: 景衝將軍王僧志陳，僧志小縮，霸先遣將軍安陸徐度將弩手二千橫截其後，景兵乃卻。

translations.literal: Jing's assault general Wang Sengzhi formed battle lines; Sengzhi shrank back slightly; Baxian sent General Xu Du of Anlu with two thousand crossbowmen to cut across their rear, and Jing's troops then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Jing's assault general Wang Sengzhi formed up; Sengzhi faltered; Baxian sent General Xu Du of Anlu with two thousand crossbowmen to cut their rear, and Jing's troops withdrew.

sentences.zh: 霸先與王琳、杜龕等以鐵騎乘之，僧辯以大軍繼進，景兵敗退，據其柵。

translations.literal: Baxian with Wang Lin, Du Kan, and others charged with iron cavalry; Sengbian followed with the great army; Jing's troops were defeated and withdrew to their palisades.
translations.idiomatic: Baxian with Wang Lin, Du Kan, and others charged with iron cavalry; Sengbian followed with the main army; Jing's troops fell back to their palisades.

sentences.zh: 龕，岸之兄子也。

translations.literal: Kan was An's elder brother's son.
translations.idiomatic: Kan was An's nephew.

sentences.zh: 景儀同三司盧暉略守石頭城，開北門降，僧辯入據之。

translations.literal: Jing's Palace Attendant of the Third Rank Lu Huiyue guarded Shitou city, opened the north gate and surrendered; Sengbian entered and took it.
translations.idiomatic: Jing's Palace Attendant of the Third Rank Lu Huiyue held Shitou, opened the north gate and surrendered; Sengbian entered and took it.

sentences.zh: 景與霸先殊死戰，景帥百餘騎，棄槊執刀，左右衝陳。

translations.literal: Jing fought Baxian to the death; Jing led more than a hundred horsemen, cast aside his spear and took a blade, and charged left and right through the lines.
translations.idiomatic: Jing fought Baxian to the death; leading more than a hundred horsemen, he cast aside his spear, took a blade, and charged left and right through the lines.

sentences.zh: 陳不動，眾遂大潰，諸軍逐北至西明門。

translations.literal: The lines did not break; his host then collapsed in great rout; the armies pursued north to Ximing Gate.
translations.idiomatic: The lines held; his host collapsed; the armies pursued to Ximing Gate.

sentences.zh: 景至闕下，不敢入台，召王偉責之曰：「爾令我為帝，今日誤我！

translations.literal: Jing reached the gate-towers but dared not enter the palace; he summoned Wang Wei and reproached him, saying, "You made me emperor—today you have ruined me!
translations.idiomatic: Jing reached the gate-towers but dared not enter the palace; he summoned Wang Wei and said, "You made me emperor—you have ruined me today!

sentences.zh: 」偉不能對，繞闕而藏。

translations.literal: " Wei could not answer and circled the gate-towers hiding.
translations.idiomatic: " Wei could not answer and hid circling the gate-towers.

sentences.zh: 景欲走，偉執鞚諫曰：「自古豈有叛天子邪！

translations.literal: Jing wished to flee; Wei seized his bridle and remonstrated, "Since antiquity has there ever been one who betrayed the Son of Heaven?
translations.idiomatic: Jing wished to flee; Wei seized his bridle: "Since antiquity, has anyone betrayed the Son of Heaven?

sentences.zh: 宮中衛士，猶足一戰，棄此，將欲安之？

translations.literal: The palace guards are still enough for one battle—abandon this, and where will you go?
translations.idiomatic: The palace guards are still enough for one battle—abandon this, and where will you go?

sentences.zh: 」景曰：「我昔敗賀拔勝，破葛榮，揚名河、朔，度江平台城，降柳仲禮如反掌；

translations.literal: " Jing said, "I once defeated Heba Sheng, broke Ge Rong, made my name on the Yellow and the north, crossed the river and took the palace city, and reduced Liu Zhongli as easily as turning my palm.
translations.idiomatic: " Jing said, "I once defeated Heba Sheng, broke Ge Rong, made my name on the Yellow and the north, crossed the river and took the palace city, and reduced Liu Zhongli as easily as turning my palm.

sentences.zh: 今日天亡我也！

translations.literal: Today Heaven destroys me!
translations.idiomatic: Today Heaven destroys me!

sentences.zh: 」因仰觀石闕，歎息久之。

translations.literal: " He then looked up at the stone gate-towers and sighed for a long while.
translations.idiomatic: " He looked up at the stone gate-towers and sighed for a long while.

sentences.zh: 以皮囊盛其江東所生二子，掛之鞍後，與房世貴等百餘騎東走，欲就謝答仁於吳。

translations.literal: He put his two sons born east of the river into leather sacks and hung them behind his saddle; with Fang Shigui and more than a hundred horsemen he fled east, intending to join Xie Daren in Wu.
translations.idiomatic: He put his two sons born east of the river into leather sacks and hung them behind his saddle; with Fang Shigui and more than a hundred horsemen he fled east toward Xie Daren in Wu.

sentences.zh: 侯子鑒、王偉、陳慶奔朱方。

translations.literal: Hou Zijian, Wang Wei, and Chen Qing fled to Zhufang.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Zijian, Wang Wei, and Chen Qing fled to Zhufang.

sentences.zh: 僧辯命裴之橫、杜龕屯杜姥宅，杜崱入據台城。

translations.literal: Sengbian ordered Pei Zhiheng and Du Kan to encamp at Old Lady Du's residence; Du Ya entered and took the palace city.
translations.idiomatic: Sengbian ordered Pei Zhiheng and Du Kan to encamp at Old Lady Du's residence; Du Ya entered and took the palace city.

sentences.zh: 僧辯不戢軍士，剽掠居民。

translations.literal: Sengbian did not restrain his soldiers; they plundered the people.
translations.idiomatic: Sengbian did not restrain his soldiers; they plundered the people.

sentences.zh: 男女裸露，自石頭至於東城，號泣滿道。

translations.literal: Men and women stripped bare; from Shitou to the eastern city, wailing filled the roads.
translations.idiomatic: Men and women stripped bare; from Shitou to the eastern city, wailing filled the roads.

sentences.zh: 是夜，軍士遺火。

translations.literal: That night soldiers left fire behind.
translations.idiomatic: That night soldiers set fires.

sentences.zh: 焚太極殿及東西堂，寶器、羽儀、輦輅無遺。

translations.literal: The Hall of Supreme Pole and the eastern and western halls were burned; treasures, feather regalia, and imperial carriages—nothing remained.
translations.idiomatic: The Hall of Supreme Pole and the eastern and western halls burned; treasures, feather regalia, and imperial carriages—nothing remained.

sentences.zh: 戊子，僧辯命侯瑱等帥精甲五千追景。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Sengbian ordered Hou Tian and others to lead five thousand picked armored men in pursuit of Jing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Sengbian ordered Hou Tian and others to pursue Jing with five thousand picked armored men.

sentences.zh: 王克、元羅等帥台內舊臣迎僧辯於道，僧辯勞克曰：「甚苦，事夷狄之君。

translations.literal: Wang Ke, Yuan Luo, and others led the old ministers within the palace to welcome Sengbian on the road; Sengbian comforted Ke, saying, "You have suffered greatly, serving a barbarian lord.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ke, Yuan Luo, and others led the old palace ministers to welcome Sengbian on the road; Sengbian said to Ke, "You have suffered greatly, serving a barbarian lord.

sentences.zh: 」克不能對。

translations.literal: " Ke could not answer.
translations.idiomatic: " Ke could not answer.

sentences.zh: 又問：「璽紱何在？

translations.literal: He asked again, "Where are the seal and cord?
translations.idiomatic: He asked again, "Where are the seal and cord?

sentences.zh: 」克良久曰：「趙平原持去。

translations.literal: " After a long while Ke said, "Zhao Pingyuan took them away.
translations.idiomatic: " After a long while Ke said, "Zhao Pingyuan took them.

sentences.zh: 」僧辯曰：「王氏百世卿族，一朝而墜。

translations.literal: " Sengbian said, "The Wang clan, a hundred generations of ministerial houses, in one morning fell.
translations.idiomatic: " Sengbian said, "The Wang clan—a hundred generations of ministerial houses—in one morning fell.

sentences.zh: 」僧辯迎太宗梓宮升朝堂，帥百官哭踴如禮。

translations.literal: " Sengbian welcomed Emperor Taizong's outer coffin up to the audience hall and led the hundred officials in weeping and stamping according to rite.
translations.idiomatic: " Sengbian brought Emperor Taizong's outer coffin to the audience hall and led the hundred officials in the prescribed mourning.

sentences.zh: 己丑，僧辯等上表勸進，且迎都建業。

translations.literal: On jichou, Sengbian and others submitted a memorial urging accession and also invited the capital to be moved to Jianye.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Sengbian and others urged accession and invited the capital to Jianye.

sentences.zh: 湘東王答曰：「淮海長鯨，雖雲授首；

translations.literal: The Prince of Xiangdong replied, "The long whale of Huaihai, though said to have surrendered its head.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Xiangdong replied, "The long whale of Huaihai, though said to have lost its head.

sentences.zh: 襄陽短狐，未全革面。

translations.literal: The short fox of Xiangyang has not yet fully changed its face.
translations.idiomatic: The short fox of Xiangyang has not yet fully changed its face.

sentences.zh: 太平玉燭，爾乃議之。

translations.literal: The jade candle of great peace—only then discuss it.
translations.idiomatic: The jade candle of great peace—only then shall we discuss it.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，南兗州刺史郭元建、秦郡戍主郭正買、陽平戍主魯伯和、行南徐州事郭子仲，並據城降。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Southern Yanzhou Inspector Guo Yuanjian, Qin commandery garrison commander Guo Zhengmai, Yangping garrison commander Lu Bohe, and acting Southern Xuzhou administrator Guo Zizhong all held their cities and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Southern Yanzhou inspector Guo Yuanjian, Qin commandery garrison commander Guo Zhengmai, Yangping garrison commander Lu Bohe, and acting Southern Xuzhou administrator Guo Zizhong all surrendered their cities.

sentences.zh: 僧辯之發江陵也，啟湘東王曰：「平賊之後，嗣君萬福，未審何以為禮？

translations.literal: When Sengbian set out from Jiangling, he memorialized the Prince of Xiangdong, saying, "After the rebels are pacified, may the heir enjoy ten thousand blessings—but I do not know what rites should be used?
translations.idiomatic: When Sengbian set out from Jiangling, he wrote the Prince of Xiangdong: "After the rebels are pacified, may the heir live in ten thousand blessings—but what rites should be used?

sentences.zh: 」王曰：「六門之內，自極兵威。

translations.literal: " The prince said, "Within the six gates, apply military authority to the utmost.
translations.idiomatic: " The prince said, "Within the six gates, apply military authority to the utmost.

sentences.zh: 」僧辯曰：「討賊之謀，臣為己任，成濟之事，請別舉人。

translations.literal: " Sengbian said, "The plan to destroy the rebels is my own charge; the matter of Cheng Ji, please choose another man.
translations.idiomatic: " Sengbian said, "The plan to destroy the rebels is mine; the matter of Cheng Ji, choose another man.

sentences.zh: 」王乃密諭宣猛將軍朱買臣，使為之所。

translations.literal: " The prince then secretly instructed Fierce General Zhu Maichen to handle it.
translations.idiomatic: " The prince secretly instructed Fierce General Zhu Maichen to handle it.

sentences.zh: 及景敗，太宗已殂，豫章王棟及二弟橋、樛相扶出於密室，逢杜崱則於道，為去其鎖。

translations.literal: When Jing was defeated, Emperor Taizong was already dead; Prince Dong of Yuzhang and his two younger brothers Qiao and Jiu supported each other out of the secret chamber; they met Du Ya on the road, who removed their locks.
translations.idiomatic: When Jing fell, Emperor Taizong was already dead; Prince Dong of Yuzhang and his brothers Qiao and Jiu supported each other out of the secret chamber; Du Ya met them on the road and removed their locks.

sentences.zh: 二弟曰：「今日始免橫死矣！

translations.literal: The two younger brothers said, "Today at last we escape violent death!
translations.idiomatic: The younger brothers said, "Today at last we escape violent death!

sentences.zh: 」棟曰：「倚伏難知，吾猶有懼！

translations.literal: " Dong said, "Fortune and misfortune are hard to know—I still have fear!
translations.idiomatic: " Dong said, "Fortune and misfortune are hard to know—I am still afraid!

sentences.zh: 」辛卯，遇朱買臣，呼之就船共飲，未竟，並沉於水。

translations.literal: " On xinmao they met Zhu Maichen; he called them aboard a boat to drink together; before they finished, all were sunk in the water.
translations.idiomatic: " On xinmao they met Zhu Maichen; he called them aboard to drink; before they finished, he drowned them all.

sentences.zh: 僧辯遣陳霸先將兵向廣陵受郭元建等降，又遣使者往安慰之。

translations.literal: Sengbian sent Chen Baxian with troops toward Guangling to receive the surrender of Guo Yuanjian and others, and also sent envoys to comfort them.
translations.idiomatic: Sengbian sent Chen Baxian toward Guangling to accept the surrender of Guo Yuanjian and others, and sent envoys to reassure them.

sentences.zh: 諸將多私使別索馬仗，會侯子鑒度江至廣陵，謂元建等曰：「我曹，梁之深仇，何顏復見其主！

translations.literal: Many generals privately sent separate envoys demanding horses and arms; when Hou Zijian crossed the river to Guangling, he said to Yuanjian and others, "We are the Liang's deepest enemies—what face have we to see their lord again!
translations.idiomatic: Many generals privately sent envoys demanding horses and arms; when Hou Zijian crossed to Guangling, he told Yuanjian and others, "We are the Liang's deepest enemies—what face have we to see their lord again!

sentences.zh: 不若投北，可得還鄉。

translations.literal: Better submit to the north and gain return to our homelands.
translations.idiomatic: Better submit to the north and go home.

sentences.zh: 」遂皆降齊。

translations.literal: " Thereupon all surrendered to Qi.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon all surrendered to Qi.

sentences.zh: 霸先至歐陽，齊行台辛術已據廣陵。

translations.literal: Baxian reached Ouyang; Qi's mobile headquarters Xin Shu had already taken Guangling.
translations.idiomatic: Baxian reached Ouyang; Qi's mobile headquarters Xin Shu had already taken Guangling.

sentences.zh: 王偉與侯子鑒相失，直瀆戍主黃公喜獲之，送建康。

translations.literal: Wang Wei lost contact with Hou Zijian; the garrison commander of Zhidu, Huang Gongxi, captured him and sent him to Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Wei lost Hou Zijian; Huang Gongxi, garrison commander of Zhidu, captured him and sent him to Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 王僧辯問曰：「卿為賊相，不能死節，而求活草間邪？

translations.literal: Wang Sengbian asked, "You served as the rebels' chancellor and could not die for your integrity—do you seek life among the weeds?
translations.idiomatic: Wang Sengbian asked, "You were the rebels' chancellor and could not die with honor—do you seek life in the weeds?

sentences.zh: 」偉曰：「廢興，命也。

translations.literal: " Wei said, "Rise and fall are fate.
translations.idiomatic: " Wei said, "Rise and fall are fate.

sentences.zh: 使漢帝早從偉言，明公豈有今日！

translations.literal: Had the Han emperor early followed Wei's words, would you, my lord, have today!
translations.idiomatic: Had the Han emperor early followed my counsel, would you, my lord, have today!

sentences.zh: 」尚書左丞虞騭嘗為偉所辱，乃唾其面。

translations.literal: " Left Assistant Minister of Works Yu Chi had once been insulted by Wei and spat in his face.
translations.idiomatic: " Left Assistant Minister Yu Chi, whom Wei had once insulted, spat in his face.

sentences.zh: 偉曰：「君不讀書，不足與語！

translations.literal: Wei said, "You do not read books—not worth speaking with!
translations.idiomatic: Wei said, "You do not read—not worth speaking with!

sentences.zh: 」騭慚而退。

translations.literal: " Chi withdrew in shame.
translations.idiomatic: " Chi withdrew in shame.

sentences.zh: 僧辯命羅州刺史徐嗣徽鎮朱方。

translations.literal: Sengbian ordered Luozhou Inspector Xu Sihui to garrison Zhufang.
translations.idiomatic: Sengbian ordered Luozhou inspector Xu Sihui to garrison Zhufang.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，侯景至晉陵，得田遷餘兵，因驅掠居民，東趨吳郡。

translations.literal: On renchen, Hou Jing reached Jinling, took Tian Qian's remaining troops, drove and plundered the people, and pressed east toward Wu commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Hou Jing reached Jinling, took Tian Qian's remaining troops, plundered the people, and pressed east toward Wu commandery.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，齊主使大都督潘樂與郭元建將兵五萬攻陽平。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, the Qi emperor sent Grand Commander Pan Yue and Guo Yuanjian to lead fifty thousand troops against Yangping.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, the Qi emperor sent Grand Commander Pan Yue and Guo Yuanjian with fifty thousand men against Yangping.

sentences.zh: 拔之。

translations.literal: They took it.
translations.idiomatic: They took it.

sentences.zh: 王僧辯啟陳霸先鎮京口。

translations.literal: Wang Sengbian memorialized that Chen Baxian should garrison Jingkou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Sengbian asked that Chen Baxian garrison Jingkou.

sentences.zh: 益州刺史、太尉武陵王紀，頗有武略，在蜀十七年，南開寧州、越巂，西通資陵、吐谷渾，內修耕桑鹽鐵之政，外通商賈遠方之利，故能殖其財用，器甲殷積，有馬八千匹。

translations.literal: Yizhou Inspector and Grand Commandant Prince Ji of Wuling was quite skilled in military affairs; in Shu for seventeen years he opened Ningzhou and Yuexi to the south, connected to Ziling and Tuyuhun to the west, within cultivated farming, silkworms, salt, and iron, without traded with merchants for distant profit, and so amassed wealth, piled arms and armor in abundance, and had eight thousand horses.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhou inspector and Grand Commandant Prince Ji of Wuling was skilled in war; seventeen years in Shu he opened Ningzhou and Yuexi to the south, reached Ziling and Tuyuhun to the west, within cultivated farming, salt, and iron, without traded for distant profit, amassed wealth, stockpiled arms, and had eight thousand horses.

sentences.zh: 聞侯景陷台城，湘東王將討之，謂僚佐曰：「七官文士，豈能匡濟！

translations.literal: Hearing that Hou Jing had taken the palace city and that the Prince of Xiangdong was about to campaign against him, he told his staff, "The seven officials are literary men—how can they save the realm!
translations.idiomatic: Hearing that Hou Jing had taken the palace city and the Prince of Xiangdong was marching against him, he told his staff, "The seven princes are literary men—how can they save the realm!

sentences.zh: 」內寢柏殿柱繞節生花，紀以為己瑞。

translations.literal: " In the inner chamber of the cypress hall, knots on the pillars flowered; Ji took this as his own auspice.
translations.idiomatic: " In the inner cypress hall, knots on the pillars flowered; Ji took it as his own omen.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，即皇帝位，改元天正，立子圓照為皇太子，圓正為西陽王，圓滿為竟陵王，圓普為譙王，圓肅為宜都王。

translations.literal: On yisi, he took the imperial throne, changed the era name to Tianzheng, made son Yuanzhao crown prince, Yuanzheng Prince of Xiyang, Yuanman Prince of Jingling, Yuanpu Prince of Qiao, and Yuansu Prince of Yidu.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, he took the throne, changed the era name to Tianzheng, made son Yuanzhao crown prince, Yuanzheng Prince of Xiyang, Yuanman Prince of Jingling, Yuanpu Prince of Qiao, and Yuansu Prince of Yidu.

sentences.zh: 以巴西、梓潼二郡太守永豐侯手為為征西大將軍、益州刺史，封秦郡王。

translations.literal: He made Shouwei, Marquis of Yongfeng, Administrator of the two commanderies Baxi and Zitong, Grand General Who Conquers the West and Inspector of Yizhou, and enfeoffed him as Prince of Qin commandery.
translations.idiomatic: He made Shouwei, Marquis of Yongfeng, administrator of Baxi and Zitong, Grand General Who Conquers the West and inspector of Yizhou, and enfeoffed him as Prince of Qin commandery.

sentences.zh: 司馬王僧略、直兵參軍徐怦固諫，不從。

translations.literal: Chief Administrator Wang Senglue and Direct Troops Aide Xu Zheng remonstrated firmly; he would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Administrator Wang Senglue and Direct Troops Aide Xu Zheng remonstrated firmly; he would not listen.

sentences.zh: 僧略，僧辯之弟；

translations.literal: Senglue was Sengbian's younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: Senglue was Sengbian's younger brother.

sentences.zh: 怦，勉之從子也。

translations.literal: Zheng was Mian's nephew.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng was Mian's nephew.

sentences.zh: 初，台城之圍，怦勸紀速入援，紀意不欲行，內銜之。

translations.literal: Earlier, during the siege of the palace city, Zheng urged Ji to enter quickly in relief; Ji did not wish to go and harbored resentment within.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, during the siege of the palace city, Zheng had urged Ji to march quickly in relief; Ji had not wished to go and harbored resentment.

sentences.zh: 會蜀人費合告怦反，怦有與將帥書云：「事事往人口具。

translations.literal: It happened that the Shu man Fei He reported that Zheng was rebelling; Zheng had a letter to a commander saying, "Every matter is to be delivered in person by mouth.
translations.idiomatic: A Shu man named Fei He reported that Zheng was rebelling; Zheng had written a commander, "Every matter is to be delivered in person by mouth.

sentences.zh: 」紀即以為反征，謂怦曰：「以卿舊情，當使諸子無恙。

translations.literal: " Ji at once took this as evidence of rebellion and told Zheng, "Out of our old bond, I shall see that your sons come to no harm.
translations.idiomatic: " Ji took this as proof of rebellion and told Zheng, "For our old bond, I shall see that your sons come to no harm.

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「生兒悉如殿下，留之何益！

translations.literal: " He answered, "If sons are all like Your Highness, what good is keeping them!
translations.idiomatic: " He answered, "If sons are all like Your Highness, what good is keeping them!

sentences.zh: 」紀乃盡誅之，梟首於市，亦殺王僧略。

translations.literal: " Ji then executed them all, displayed their heads in the market, and also killed Wang Senglue.
translations.idiomatic: " Ji executed them all, displayed their heads in the market, and killed Wang Senglue as well.

sentences.zh: 永豐侯手為歎曰：「王事不成矣！

translations.literal: Marquis Shouwei of Yongfeng sighed and said, "The royal enterprise is finished!
translations.idiomatic: Marquis Shouwei of Yongfeng sighed: "The royal enterprise is finished!

sentences.zh: 善人，國之基也，今先殺之，不亡何待！

translations.literal: Good men are the foundation of a state—now killing them first, how can it not perish!
translations.idiomatic: Good men are the foundation of a state—kill them first, and what is left but ruin!

sentences.zh: 紀征宜豐侯咨議參軍劉璠為中書侍郎，使者八反，乃至。

translations.literal: Ji summoned Liu Fan, Consultant of the Marquis of Yifeng, as Palace Secretary; envoys went back and forth eight times before he came.
translations.idiomatic: Ji summoned Liu Fan, consultant of the Marquis of Yifeng, as Palace Secretary; envoys went back and forth eight times before he came.

sentences.zh: 紀令劉孝勝深布腹心，璠苦求還。

translations.literal: Ji had Liu Xiaosheng lay bare his inmost heart; Fan urgently asked to return.
translations.idiomatic: Ji had Liu Xiaosheng speak his inmost mind; Fan urgently asked to return.

sentences.zh: 中記室韋登私謂璠曰：「殿下忍而畜憾，足下不留，將致大禍，孰若共構大夏，使身名俱美哉！

translations.literal: Central Recorder Wei Deng privately told Fan, "His Highness is forbearing yet hoards grievance; if you do not stay, great disaster will come—why not together build a great house and make body and name both fair!
translations.idiomatic: Central Recorder Wei Deng told Fan privately, "His Highness is patient but hoards grievance; if you do not stay, disaster follows—why not build a great enterprise together and win honor for us both?

sentences.zh: 」璠正色曰：「卿欲緩頰於我邪？

translations.literal: " Fan said sternly, "Do you wish to plead for me?
translations.idiomatic: " Fan said sternly, "Do you wish to plead for me?

sentences.zh: 我與府侯分義已定，豈以夷險易其心乎！

translations.literal: My bond with the marquis is fixed in duty—how could I change my heart for ease or peril!
translations.idiomatic: My bond with the marquis is fixed—how could ease or peril change my heart!

sentences.zh: 殿下方布大義於天下，終不逞志於一夫。

translations.literal: His Highness is now spreading great righteousness through the realm—he will never vent his will on one man.
translations.idiomatic: His Highness spreads righteousness through the realm—he will never vent his will on one man.

sentences.zh: 」紀知必不為己用，乃厚禮遣之。

translations.literal: " Ji knew he would never serve him and so sent him away with rich gifts.
translations.idiomatic: " Ji knew Fan would never serve him and sent him away with rich gifts.

sentences.zh: 以宜豐侯循為益州刺史，封隨郡王，以璠為循府長史、蜀郡太守。

translations.literal: He made the Marquis of Yifeng, Xun, Inspector of Yizhou and enfeoffed him as Prince of Sui commandery, and made Fan Xun's chief secretary and Administrator of Shu commandery.
translations.idiomatic: He made the Marquis of Yifeng, Xun, inspector of Yizhou and Prince of Sui commandery, and made Fan Xun's chief secretary and administrator of Shu commandery.

sentences.zh: 謝答仁討劉神茂還，至富陽，聞侯景敗走，帥萬人欲北出候之，趙伯超據錢塘拒之。

translations.literal: Xie Daren, returning from campaigning against Liu Shenma, reached Fuyang; hearing that Hou Jing had been defeated and was fleeing, he led ten thousand men wishing to go north to meet him; Zhao Bochao held Qiantang and barred him.
translations.idiomatic: Xie Daren, returning from the campaign against Liu Shenma, reached Fuyang; hearing Hou Jing was fleeing, he led ten thousand men north to meet him; Zhao Bochao held Qiantang and barred him.

sentences.zh: 侯景進至嘉興，聞伯超叛之，乃退據吳。

translations.literal: Hou Jing advanced to Jiaxing; hearing that Bochao had rebelled against him, he withdrew and held Wu.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jing advanced to Jiaxing; hearing Bochao had turned on him, he withdrew to Wu.

sentences.zh: 己酉，侯瑱追及景於松江，景猶有船二百艘，眾數千人，瑱進擊，敗之，擒彭雋、田遷、房世貴、蔡壽樂、王伯丑。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Hou Tian overtook Jing at Songjiang; Jing still had two hundred ships and several thousand men; Tian pressed the attack, defeated him, and captured Peng Juan, Tian Qian, Fang Shigui, Cai Shoule, and Wang Bochou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Hou Tian overtook Jing at Songjiang; Jing still had two hundred ships and several thousand men; Tian attacked, routed him, and captured Peng Juan, Tian Qian, Fang Shigui, Cai Shoule, and Wang Bochou.

sentences.zh: 瑱生剖雋腹，抽其腸。

translations.literal: Tian cut open Juan's belly alive and drew out his intestines.
translations.idiomatic: Tian cut Juan's belly open alive and drew out his intestines.

sentences.zh: 雋猶不死，手自收之，乃斬之。

translations.literal: Juan still did not die; with his own hands he gathered them in, and only then was he beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: Juan still lived; with his own hands he gathered them in, and only then was he beheaded.

sentences.zh: 景與腹心數十人單舸走，推墮二子於水，將入海，瑱遣副將焦僧度追之。

translations.literal: Jing with several dozen trusted men fled in a single boat, pushed his two sons into the water, and was about to go to sea; Tian sent Deputy General Jiao Songdu in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: Jing fled in a single boat with several dozen trusted men, pushed his two sons into the water, and headed for the sea; Tian sent Deputy General Jiao Songdu in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 景納羊侃之女為小妻，以其兄昆為庫直都督，待之甚厚。

translations.literal: Jing had taken Yang Kan's daughter as a minor wife and made her elder brother Kun Director of the Palace Armory, treating him very generously.
translations.idiomatic: Jing had taken Yang Kan's daughter as a concubine and made her brother Kun Director of the Palace Armory, treating him generously.

sentences.zh: 昆隨景東走，與景所親王元禮、謝葳蕤密圖之。

translations.literal: Kun followed Jing east and with Jing's intimate Wang Yuanli and Xie Weirui secretly plotted against him.
translations.idiomatic: Kun followed Jing east and with Jing's intimates Wang Yuanli and Xie Weirui secretly plotted against him.

sentences.zh: 葳蕤，答仁之弟也。

translations.literal: Weirui was Daren's younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: Weirui was Daren's younger brother.

sentences.zh: 景下海，欲向蒙山，己卯，景晝寢；

translations.literal: Jing went down to the sea intending to head for Meng Mountain; on jimao, Jing napped by day.
translations.idiomatic: Jing put to sea intending for Meng Mountain; on jimao he napped by day.

sentences.zh: 昆語海師：「此中何處有蒙山，汝但聽我處分。

translations.literal: Kun told the sea pilot, "Where is there Meng Mountain here—you need only obey my orders.
translations.idiomatic: Kun told the pilot, "Where is Meng Mountain here—you need only obey me.

sentences.zh: 」遂直向京口。

translations.literal: " Thereupon they headed straight for Jingkou.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon they headed straight for Jingkou.

sentences.zh: 至胡豆洲，景覺，大驚；

translations.literal: When they reached Houdou Isle, Jing awoke, greatly alarmed;
translations.idiomatic: When they reached Houdou Isle, Jing awoke in alarm;

sentences.zh: 問岸上人，云「郭元建猶在廣陵」，景大喜，將依之。

translations.literal: he asked people on the shore, who said, "Guo Yuanjian is still at Guangling"; Jing was overjoyed and meant to rely on him.
translations.idiomatic: he asked people on the shore, who said, "Guo Yuanjian is still at Guangling"; Jing was overjoyed and meant to go to him.

sentences.zh: 昆拔刀，叱海師向京口，因謂景曰：「吾等為王效力多矣，今至於此，終無所成，欲就乞頭以取富貴。

translations.literal: Kun drew his blade, shouted at the helmsman to steer for Jingkou, and said to Jing, "We have served Your Majesty long and hard; now it has come to this with nothing achieved—we mean to beg your head for wealth and rank.
translations.idiomatic: Kun drew his blade, shouted at the helmsman to steer for Jingkou, and told Jing, "We have served you long and hard; now it has come to nothing—we mean to take your head for our reward."

sentences.zh: 」景未及答，白刃交下。

translations.literal: " Before Jing could answer, white blades struck from every side.
translations.idiomatic: " Before Jing could answer, blades flashed down on every side.

sentences.zh: 景欲投水，昆以刀斫之。

translations.literal: Jing tried to throw himself into the water; Kun hacked him with a blade.
translations.idiomatic: Jing tried to throw himself into the water; Kun hacked at him with a blade.

sentences.zh: 景走入船中，以佩刀抉船底，昆以槊刺殺之。

translations.literal: Jing ran into the boat and gouged the bottom with his belt dagger; Kun speared and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Jing ran into the boat and gouged the hull with his belt dagger; Kun ran him through with a spear and killed him.

sentences.zh: 尚書右僕射索超世在別船，葳蕤以景命召而執之。

translations.literal: Right Vice Director of the Secretariat Suo Chaoshi was on another vessel; Weirui summoned and seized him in Jing's name.
translations.idiomatic: Right vice director of the secretariat Suo Chaoshi was on another vessel; Weirui summoned and seized him in Jing's name.

sentences.zh: 南徐州刺史徐嗣徽斬超世，以鹽內景腹中，送其屍於建康。

translations.literal: Southern Xuzhou Inspector Xu Siwei beheaded Chaoshi, packed Jing's belly with salt, and sent the corpse to Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Xuzhou inspector Xu Siwei beheaded Chaoshi, packed Jing's belly with salt, and sent the corpse to Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 僧辯傳首江陵，截其手，使謝葳蕤送於齊；

translations.literal: Senbian sent the head to Jiangling and cut off the hands, had Xie Weirui deliver them to Qi;
translations.idiomatic: Senbian sent the head to Jiangling and cut off the hands, and had Xie Weirui deliver them to Qi;

sentences.zh: 暴景屍於市，士民爭取食之，並骨皆盡；

translations.literal: Jing's corpse was exposed in the market; gentlemen and commoners scrambled to eat it until even the bones were gone;
translations.idiomatic: Jing's corpse was exposed in the market; townspeople scrambled to eat it until even the bones were gone;

sentences.zh: 溧陽公主亦預食焉。

translations.literal: the Princess of Liyang also took part in the eating.
translations.idiomatic: even the Princess of Liyang took part.

sentences.zh: 初，景之五子在北齊，世宗剝其長子面而烹之，幼者皆下蠶室。

translations.literal: Earlier, Jing's five sons were in Northern Qi; Shizong flayed the eldest's face and boiled him, and the younger ones were all sent to the silkworm house.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Jing's five sons were in Northern Qi; Emperor Wenxuan flayed the eldest's face and boiled him, and the younger ones were all castrated.

sentences.zh: 齊顯祖即位，夢獼猴坐其御床，乃盡烹之。

translations.literal: When Qi Emperor Xianzu took the throne, he dreamed a macaque sat on his imperial couch and then had them all boiled.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wenxuan of Qi took the throne, he dreamed a macaque sat on his imperial couch and had them all boiled.

sentences.zh: 趙伯超、謝答仁皆降於侯瑱，瑱並田遷等送建康。

translations.literal: Zhao Bochao and Xie Daren both surrendered to Hou Chen; Chen sent them with Tian Qian and others to Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Bochao and Xie Daren both surrendered to Hou Chen; Chen sent them with Tian Qian and others to Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 王僧辯斬房世貴於市，送王偉、呂季略、周石珍、嚴但、趙伯超、伏知命於江陵。

translations.literal: Wang Senbian executed Fang Shigui in the market and sent Wang Wei, Lü Jilüe, Zhou Shizhen, Yan Dan, Zhao Bochao, and Fu Zhiming to Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Senbian executed Fang Shigui in the market and sent Wang Wei, Lü Jilüe, Zhou Shizhen, Yan Dan, Zhao Bochao, and Fu Zhiming to Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，湘東王下令解嚴。

translations.literal: On dingsi, the Prince of Xiangdong ordered the lifting of martial law.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Prince Xiao Yi of Xiangdong ordered the lifting of martial law.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，葬簡文帝於莊陵，廟號太宗。

translations.literal: On yichou, Emperor Jianwen was buried at Zhuangling; his temple name was Taizong.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Emperor Jianwen was buried at Zhuangling; his temple name was Taizong.

sentences.zh: 侯景之敗也，以傳國璽自隨，使其侍中兼平原太守趙思賢掌之，曰：「若我死，宜沉於江，勿令吳兒復得之。

translations.literal: When Hou Jing was defeated, he carried the imperial seal with him and had his attendant-in-ordinary and concurrent Administrator of Pingyuan Zhao Sixian keep it, saying, "If I die, sink it in the river—do not let the Wu men get it again.
translations.idiomatic: When Hou Jing was defeated, he carried the imperial seal with him and had attendant-in-ordinary and concurrent administrator of Pingyuan Zhao Sixian keep it, saying, "If I die, sink it in the river—do not let the southerners have it again."

sentences.zh: 」思賢自京口濟江，遇盜，從者棄之草間，至廣陵，以告郭元建。

translations.literal: " Sixian crossed the river from Jingkou, met bandits, and his attendants abandoned it in the grass; reaching Guangling, he told Guo Yuanjian.
translations.idiomatic: " Sixian crossed the river from Jingkou, met bandits, and his attendants abandoned it in the grass; reaching Guangling, he told Guo Yuanjian.

sentences.zh: 元建取之，以與辛術，壬申，術送之至鄴。

translations.literal: Yuanjian took it and gave it to Xin Shu; on renshen, Shu sent it to Ye.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanjian took it and gave it to Xin Shu; on renshen, Shu sent it to Ye.

sentences.zh: 甲申，齊以吏部尚書楊愔為右僕射，以太原公主妻之。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Qi made Minister of Personnel Yang Yin Right Vice Director and gave him the Princess of Taiyuan in marriage.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Qi made minister of personnel Yang Yin right vice director and gave him the Princess of Taiyuan in marriage.

sentences.zh: 公主即魏孝靜帝之後也。

translations.literal: The princess was a daughter of Wei Emperor Xiaojing.
translations.idiomatic: The princess was a daughter of Wei Emperor Xiaojing.

sentences.zh: 楊乾運至劍北，魏達奚武逆擊之，大破乾運於白馬，陳其俘馘於南鄭城下，且遣人辱宜豐侯循。

translations.literal: Yang Qianyun reached north of Jian; Wei's Daqixin Wu met and struck him, routing Qianyun at Baima, displayed captives and heads below Nanzheng, and also sent men to insult Marquis Xun of Yifeng.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Qianyun reached north of Jian; Western Wei's Daqixin Wu met and struck him, routing Qianyun at Baima, displayed captives and heads below Nanzheng, and sent men to insult Marquis Xiao Xun of Yifeng.

sentences.zh: 循怒，出兵與戰，都督楊紹伏兵擊之，殺傷殆盡。

translations.literal: Xun was angry, marched out to fight, and Commander Yang Shao ambushed them, killing and wounding nearly all.
translations.idiomatic: Xun was angry, marched out to fight, and commander Yang Shao ambushed them, killing and wounding nearly all.

sentences.zh: 劉愔還至白馬西，為武所獲，送長安。

translations.literal: Liu Yin, returning west of Baima, was captured by Wu and sent to Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Fan, returning west of Baima, was captured by Wu and sent to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 太師泰素聞其名，待之如舊交。

translations.literal: Grand Preceptor Tai had long heard his name and treated him as an old friend.
translations.idiomatic: Grand preceptor Yuwen Tai had long heard his name and treated him as an old friend.

sentences.zh: 時南鄭久不下，武請屠之，泰將許之。

translations.literal: Nanzheng had long not fallen; Wu asked to slaughter it, and Tai was about to consent.
translations.idiomatic: Nanzheng had long not fallen; Wu asked to slaughter it, and Tai was about to consent.

sentences.zh: 璠請之於朝，泰怒，不許；

translations.literal: Fan pleaded at court; Tai was angry and refused;
translations.idiomatic: Fan pleaded at court; Tai was angry and refused;

sentences.zh: 璠泣請不已，泰曰：「事人當如是。

translations.literal: Fan wept and pleaded without cease; Tai said, "Serving a lord should be like this.
translations.idiomatic: Fan wept and pleaded without cease; Tai said, "This is how one should serve a lord."

sentences.zh: 」乃從其請。

translations.literal: " He then granted the request.
translations.idiomatic: " He then granted the request.

sentences.zh: 五月，庚午，司空南平王恪等復勸進，湘東王猶不受，遣侍中豐城侯泰等謁山陵，修復廟社。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on gengwu, Minister of Works Prince Ke of Nanping and others again urged accession; the Prince of Xiangdong still refused and sent Attendant-in-Ordinary Marquis Tai of Fengcheng and others to visit the imperial tombs and restore the ancestral temples and altars.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengwu, minister of works Prince Xiao Ke of Nanping and others again urged accession; Prince Xiao Yi still refused and sent attendant-in-ordinary Marquis Tai of Fengcheng and others to visit the imperial tombs and restore the ancestral temples and altars.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，侯景首至江陵，梟之於市三日，煮而漆之，以付武庫。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Jing's head reached Jiangling; it was exposed in the market three days, then boiled, lacquered, and placed in the armory.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Jing's head reached Jiangling; it was exposed in the market three days, then boiled, lacquered, and placed in the armory.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以南平王恪為揚州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Prince Ke of Nanping was made Inspector of Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Prince Xiao Ke of Nanping was made inspector of Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以王僧辯為司徒、鎮衛將軍，封長寧公。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Wang Senbian was made Minister of Education and General Who Guards the Realm, enfeoffed as Duke of Changning.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Wang Senbian was made minister of education and general who guards the realm, enfeoffed as Duke of Changning.

sentences.zh: 陳霸先為征虜將軍、開府儀同三司，封長城縣侯。

translations.literal: Chen Baxian was made General Who Punishes the Barbarians, equal in honor to the three dukes with an open office, and enfeoffed as Marquis of Changcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Baxian was made general who punishes the barbarians, equal in honor to the three dukes with an open office, and enfeoffed as Marquis of Changcheng.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，誅侯景所署尚書僕射王偉、左民尚書呂季略、少府周石珍、舍人嚴但於市。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Jing's appointees—Vice Director of the Secretariat Wang Wei, Director of the Left Bureau Lü Jilüe, Chamberlain for the Palace Treasury Zhou Shizhen, and Gentleman Attendant Yan Dan—were executed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Jing's appointees—vice director of the secretariat Wang Wei, director of the left bureau Lü Jilüe, chamberlain for the palace treasury Zhou Shizhen, and gentleman attendant Yan Dan—were executed in the market.

sentences.zh: 趙伯超、伏知命餓死於獄。

translations.literal: Zhao Bochao and Fu Zhiming starved to death in prison.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Bochao and Fu Zhiming starved to death in prison.

sentences.zh: 以謝答仁不失禮於太宗，特宥之。

translations.literal: Because Xie Daren had not failed in courtesy toward Taizong, he was specially spared.
translations.idiomatic: Because Xie Daren had not failed in courtesy toward Taizong, he was specially spared.

sentences.zh: 王偉於獄中上五百言詩，湘東王愛其才，欲宥之。

translations.literal: Wang Wei submitted a five-hundred-word poem from prison; the Prince of Xiangdong admired his talent and wished to spare him.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Wei submitted a five-hundred-word poem from prison; Prince Xiao Yi admired his talent and wished to spare him.

sentences.zh: 有嫉之者，言於王曰：「前日偉作檄文甚佳。

translations.literal: One who envied him said to the prince, "The other day Wei wrote an excellent proclamation.
translations.idiomatic: A jealous courtier said to the prince, "The other day Wei wrote an excellent proclamation."

sentences.zh: 」王求而視之，檄曰：「項羽重瞳，尚有烏江之敗；

translations.literal: " The prince asked to see it; the text read, "Xiang Yu had double pupils, yet still met defeat at the Wu River;
translations.idiomatic: " The prince asked to see it; the text read, "Xiang Yu had double pupils, yet still met defeat at the Wu River;"

sentences.zh: 湘東一目，寧為赤縣所歸！

translations.literal: the Prince of Xiangdong has but one eye—how should the empire submit to him!
translations.idiomatic: the Prince of Xiangdong has but one eye—how should the empire submit to him!"

sentences.zh: 」王大怒，釘其舌於柱，剜腹、臠肉而殺之。

translations.literal: " The prince was furious, nailed his tongue to a post, disemboweled him, carved his flesh, and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: " The prince was furious, nailed his tongue to a post, disemboweled him, carved his flesh, and killed him.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，齊合州刺史斛斯昭攻歷陽，拔之。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Qi's Hezhou Inspector Husizhao attacked Liyang and took it.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Qi's Hezhou inspector Husizhao attacked Liyang and took it.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，下令，以「王偉等既死，自餘衣冠舊貴，被逼偷生，猛士勳豪，和光苟免者，皆不問。

translations.literal: On dinghai, an order was issued: "Now that Wang Wei and the rest are dead, all other gentry and old nobles who were forced to live in hiding, and bold warriors and meritorious lords who blended in to escape—all will go unpunished.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, an order was issued: "Now that Wang Wei and the rest are dead, all other gentry and old nobles who were forced to live in hiding, and bold warriors and meritorious lords who blended in to escape—all will go unpunished."

sentences.zh: 扶風民魯悉達，糾合鄉人以保新蔡，力田蓄谷。

translations.literal: Lu Sida of Fufeng gathered villagers to hold Xincai, farmed diligently, and stored grain.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Sida of Fufeng gathered villagers to hold Xincai, farmed diligently, and stored grain.

sentences.zh: 時江東饑亂，餓死者什八九，遺民攜老幼歸之。

translations.literal: The Jiangdong region was starving and in chaos; eight or nine in ten died of hunger, and survivors brought old and young to join him.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangdong region was starving and in chaos; eight or nine in ten died of hunger, and survivors brought old and young to join him.

sentences.zh: 悉達分給糧廩，全濟甚眾，招集晉熙等五郡，盡有其地。

translations.literal: Sida distributed grain from his stores and saved a great many; he gathered five commanderies including Jinxi and held all their territory.
translations.idiomatic: Sida distributed grain from his stores and saved a great many; he gathered five commanderies including Jinxi and held all their territory.

sentences.zh: 使其弟廣達將兵從王僧辯討侯景，景平，以悉達為北江州刺史。

translations.literal: He sent his younger brother Guangda with troops to follow Wang Senbian against Hou Jing; when Jing was pacified, Sida was made Inspector of Northern Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He sent his younger brother Guangda with troops to follow Wang Senbian against Hou Jing; when Jing was pacified, Sida was made inspector of Northern Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 齊主使其散騎常侍曹文皎等來聘，湘東王使散騎常侍柳暉等報之，且告平侯景；

translations.literal: The Qi ruler sent Supernumerary Cavalier Attendant Cao Wenjiao and others on a friendly mission; the Prince of Xiangdong sent Supernumerary Cavalier Attendant Liu Hui and others in reply, also announcing the pacification of Hou Jing;
translations.idiomatic: The Qi ruler sent supernumerary cavalier attendant Cao Wenjiao and others on a friendly mission; Prince Xiao Yi sent supernumerary cavalier attendant Liu Hui and others in reply, also announcing the pacification of Hou Jing;

sentences.zh: 亦遣舍人魏彥告於魏。

translations.literal: he also sent Gentleman Attendant Wei Yan to inform Wei.
translations.idiomatic: he also sent gentleman attendant Wei Yan to inform Western Wei.

sentences.zh: 齊主使潘樂、郭元建將兵圍秦郡，行台尚書辛術諫曰：「朝廷與湘東王信使不絕。

translations.literal: The Qi ruler sent Pan Yue and Guo Yuanjian with troops to besiege Qin Commandery; Mobile Secretariat Director Xin Shu remonstrated, "Court and the Prince of Xiangdong have messengers going back and forth without cease.
translations.idiomatic: The Qi ruler sent Pan Yue and Guo Yuanjian with troops to besiege Qin Commandery; mobile secretariat director Xin Shu remonstrated, "Court and Prince Xiao Yi of Xiangdong have messengers going back and forth without cease."

sentences.zh: 陽平，侯景之土，取之可也；

translations.literal: Yangping was Hou Jing's territory—taking it is acceptable;
translations.idiomatic: Yangping was Hou Jing's territory—taking it is acceptable;

sentences.zh: 今王僧辯已遣嚴超達守秦郡，於義何得復爭之！

translations.literal: but Wang Senbian has already sent Yan Chaoda to hold Qin Commandery—by what right should we fight over it again!
translations.idiomatic: but Wang Senbian has already sent Yan Chaoda to hold Qin Commandery—by what right should we fight over it again!"

sentences.zh: 且水潦方降，不如班師。

translations.literal: Moreover floods are coming down—better to withdraw the army.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover floods are coming down—better to withdraw the army."

sentences.zh: 」弗從。

translations.literal: " He was not obeyed.
translations.idiomatic: " He was not obeyed.

sentences.zh: 陳霸先命別將徐度引兵助秦郡固守。

translations.literal: Chen Baxian ordered detached general Xu Du to lead troops to help Qin Commandery hold firm.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Baxian ordered detached general Xu Du to lead troops to help Qin Commandery hold firm.

sentences.zh: 齊眾七萬，攻之甚急。

translations.literal: The Qi host numbered seventy thousand and pressed the attack fiercely.
translations.idiomatic: The Qi host numbered seventy thousand and pressed the attack fiercely.

sentences.zh: 王僧辯使左衛將軍杜崱救之，霸先亦自歐陽來會；

translations.literal: Wang Senbian sent Left Guard General Du Ya to rescue it, and Baxian also came from Ouyang to join;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Senbian sent left guard general Du Ya to rescue it, and Baxian also came from Ouyang to join;

sentences.zh: 與元建大戰於土林，大破之，斬首萬餘級，生擒千餘人，元建收餘眾北遁；

translations.literal: they fought Yuanjian in great battle at Tulin, routed him utterly, took more than ten thousand heads, captured more than a thousand alive, and Yuanjian gathered the remnant and fled north;
translations.idiomatic: they fought Yuanjian in great battle at Tulin, routed him utterly, took more than ten thousand heads, captured more than a thousand alive, and Yuanjian gathered the remnant and fled north;

sentences.zh: 猶以通好，不窮追也。

translations.literal: yet because friendly relations continued, they did not pursue to the end.
translations.idiomatic: yet because friendly relations continued, they did not pursue to the end.

sentences.zh: 辛術遷吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Xin Shu was transferred to Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Xin Shu was transferred to minister of personnel.

sentences.zh: 自魏遷鄴以來，大選之職，知名者數人，互有得失：齊世宗少年高朗，所弊者疏；

translations.literal: Since Wei moved the capital to Ye, several famous men had held the great selection office, each with strengths and flaws: Qi's Shizong was young, lofty, and clear, but his fault was laxity;
translations.idiomatic: Since Wei moved the capital to Ye, several famous men had held the great selection office, each with strengths and flaws: Qi's Shizong was young, lofty, and clear, but his fault was laxity;

sentences.zh: 袁叔德沈密謹厚，所傷者細；

translations.literal: Yuan Shude was deep, careful, and earnest, but harmed by minuteness;
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Shude was deep, careful, and earnest, but harmed by minuteness;

sentences.zh: 楊愔風流辯給，取士失於浮華。

translations.literal: Yang Yin was elegant and eloquent, but erred toward flash in choosing men.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yin was elegant and eloquent, but erred toward flash in choosing men.

sentences.zh: 唯術性尚貞明，取士必以才器，循名責實，新舊參舉，管庫必擢，門閥不遺，考之前後，最為折衷。

translations.literal: Only Shu was upright and clear in nature, always choosing men by talent and capacity, matching names to reality, mixing old and new appointments, promoting even storehouse clerks and not overlooking great houses—in all, the most balanced of them.
translations.idiomatic: Only Shu was upright and clear in nature, always choosing men by talent and capacity, matching names to reality, mixing old and new appointments, promoting even storehouse clerks and not overlooking great houses—in all, the most balanced of them.

sentences.zh: 魏達奚武遣尚書左丞柳帶韋入南鄭，說宜豐侯循曰：「足下所固者險，所恃者援，所保者民。

translations.literal: Wei's Daqixin Wu sent Left Assistant Director of the Secretariat Liu Daiwei into Nanzheng to persuade Marquis Xun of Yifeng: "What you rely on is terrain, what you count on is aid, what you guard is the people.
translations.idiomatic: Western Wei's Daqixin Wu sent left assistant director of the secretariat Liu Daiwei into Nanzheng to persuade Marquis Xiao Xun of Yifeng: "What you rely on is terrain, what you count on is aid, what you guard is the people."

sentences.zh: 今王旅深入，所憑之險不足固也；

translations.literal: Now the royal army has penetrated deep; the passes you trust are not secure enough;
translations.idiomatic: Now the royal army has penetrated deep; the passes you trust are not secure enough;

sentences.zh: 白馬破走，酋豪不進，所望之援不可恃也；

translations.literal: Baima was broken and fled, chieftains would not advance—the aid you hope for cannot be relied on;
translations.idiomatic: Baima was broken and fled, chieftains would not advance—the aid you hope for cannot be relied on;

sentences.zh: 長圍四合，所部之民不可保也。

translations.literal: long encirclement closes on four sides—the people under you cannot be protected.
translations.idiomatic: long encirclement closes on four sides—the people under you cannot be protected."

sentences.zh: 且足下本朝喪亂，社稷無主，欲誰為為忠乎！

translations.literal: Moreover your own court is in chaos and the altars have no lord—to whom would you be loyal!
translations.idiomatic: Moreover your own court is in chaos and the altars have no lord—to whom would you be loyal!"

sentences.zh: 豈若轉禍為福，使慶流子孫邪！

translations.literal: Would it not be better to turn disaster into blessing and let fortune flow to your descendants?
translations.idiomatic: Would it not be better to turn disaster into blessing and let fortune flow to your descendants?"

sentences.zh: 」循乃請降。

translations.literal: " Xun then asked to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: " Xun then asked to surrender.

sentences.zh: 帶韋，慶之子也。

translations.literal: Daiwei was Qing's son.
translations.idiomatic: Daiwei was Liu Qing's son.

sentences.zh: 開府儀同三司賀蘭德願聞城中食盡，請攻之，大都督赫連達曰：「不戰而獲城，策之上者，豈可利其子女，貪其貨財，而不愛民命乎！

translations.literal: Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes Helan Deyuan, hearing food in the city was exhausted, asked to attack; Grand Commander Helian Da said, "Taking a city without battle is the highest strategy—how can one covet their women and children, grasp their goods, and not cherish the people's lives!
translations.idiomatic: Helan Deyuan, equal in honor to the three dukes, hearing food in the city was exhausted, asked to attack; grand commander Helian Da said, "Taking a city without battle is the highest strategy—how can one covet their women and children, grasp their goods, and not cherish the people's lives!"

sentences.zh: 且觀其士馬猶強，城池尚固，攻之縱克，必彼此俱傷；

translations.literal: Moreover their soldiers and horses are still strong and the walls still firm—even if attack succeeds, both sides must be wounded;
translations.idiomatic: Moreover their soldiers and horses are still strong and the walls still firm—even if attack succeeds, both sides must be wounded;

sentences.zh: 如困獸猶鬥，則成敗未可知也。

translations.literal: if a cornered beast still fights, victory and defeat cannot be known.
translations.idiomatic: if a cornered beast still fights, victory and defeat cannot be known."

sentences.zh: 」武曰：「公言是也。

translations.literal: " Wu said, "Your words are right.
translations.idiomatic: " Wu said, "Your words are right."

sentences.zh: 」乃受循降，獲男女二萬口而還，於是劍北皆入於魏。

translations.literal: " He then accepted Xun's surrender, took twenty thousand men and women, and returned; thereupon all north of Jian passed to Wei.
translations.idiomatic: " He then accepted Xun's surrender, took twenty thousand men and women, and returned; thereupon all north of Jian passed to Western Wei.

sentences.zh: 六月，丁未，齊主還鄴；

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on dingwei, the Qi ruler returned to Ye;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingwei, the Qi ruler returned to Ye;

sentences.zh: 乙卯，復如晉陽。

translations.literal: on yimao, he went again to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: on yimao, he went again to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，立安南侯方矩為王太子。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Marquis Fangju of Annan was installed as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Marquis Fangju of Annan was installed as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 齊遣散騎常侍謝季卿來賀平侯景。

translations.literal: Qi sent Supernumerary Cavalier Attendant Xie Jiqing to congratulate the pacification of Hou Jing.
translations.idiomatic: Qi sent supernumerary cavalier attendant Xie Jiqing to congratulate the pacification of Hou Jing.

sentences.zh: 衡州刺史王懷明作亂，廣州刺史蕭勃討平之。

translations.literal: Hengzhou Inspector Wang Huaiming rebelled; Guangzhou Inspector Xiao Bo suppressed and pacified him.
translations.idiomatic: Hengzhou inspector Wang Huaiming rebelled; Guangzhou inspector Xiao Bo suppressed and pacified him.

sentences.zh: 齊政煩賦重，江北之民不樂屬齊，其豪傑數請兵於王僧辯，僧辯以與齊通好，皆不許。

translations.literal: Qi's government was burdensome and taxes heavy; people north of the Yangtze were unhappy under Qi rule, and local heroes repeatedly asked Wang Senbian for troops—Senbian, keeping friendly relations with Qi, refused all.
translations.idiomatic: Qi's government was burdensome and taxes heavy; people north of the Yangtze were unhappy under Qi rule, and local heroes repeatedly asked Wang Senbian for troops—Senbian, keeping friendly relations with Qi, refused all.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，廣陵僑人朱盛等潛聚黨數千人，謀襲殺齊刺史溫仲邕，遣使求援於陳霸先，雲已克其外城。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Zhu Sheng and other sojourners at Guangling secretly gathered several thousand partisans, plotted to surprise and kill Qi's inspector Wen Zhongyong, and sent envoys to Chen Baxian for aid, claiming the outer city was already taken.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, Zhu Sheng and other sojourners at Guangling secretly gathered several thousand partisans, plotted to surprise and kill Qi's inspector Wen Zhongyong, and sent envoys to Chen Baxian for aid, claiming the outer city was already taken.

sentences.zh: 霸先使告僧辯，僧辯曰：「人之情偽，未易可測，若審克外城，亟須應援，如其不爾，無煩進軍。

translations.literal: Baxian sent word to Senbian; Senbian said, "Human truth and falsehood are hard to gauge—if the outer city is truly taken, aid must come at once; if not, there is no need to march.
translations.idiomatic: Baxian sent word to Senbian; Senbian said, "Human truth and falsehood are hard to gauge—if the outer city is truly taken, aid must come at once; if not, there is no need to march."

sentences.zh: 」使未報，霸先已濟江，僧辯乃命武州刺史杜崱等助之。

translations.literal: " Before the envoy returned, Baxian had already crossed the river; Senbian then ordered Wuzhou Inspector Du Ya and others to assist.
translations.idiomatic: " Before the envoy returned, Baxian had already crossed the river; Senbian then ordered Wuzhou inspector Du Ya and others to assist.

sentences.zh: 會盛等謀洩，霸先因進軍圍廣陵。

translations.literal: Just then Sheng and the rest's plot leaked; Baxian therefore advanced and besieged Guangling.
translations.idiomatic: Just then Sheng and the rest's plot leaked; Baxian therefore advanced and besieged Guangling.

sentences.zh: 八月，魏安康人黃眾寶反，攻魏興，執太守柳檜，進圍東梁州。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Huang Zhongbao of Wei'an rebelled, attacked Weixing, seized Administrator Liu Gui, and advanced to besiege Eastern Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Huang Zhongbao of Wei'an rebelled, attacked Weixing, seized administrator Liu Gui, and advanced to besiege Eastern Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 令檜誘說城中，檜不從而死。

translations.literal: He ordered Gui to persuade the city to surrender; Gui refused and died.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Gui to persuade the city to surrender; Gui refused and died.

sentences.zh: 檜，虯之弟也。

translations.literal: Gui was Chiu's younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: Gui was Liu Chiu's younger brother.

sentences.zh: 太師泰遣王雄與驃騎大將軍武川宇文虯討之。

translations.literal: Grand Preceptor Tai sent Wang Xiong and Rapid-as-Tiger Grand General Yuwen Chiu of Wuchuan to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Grand preceptor Yuwen Tai sent Wang Xiong and rapid-as-tiger grand general Yuwen Chiu of Wuchuan to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 武陵王紀舉兵由外水東下，以永豐侯手為為益州刺史，守成都，使其子宜都王圓肅副之。

translations.literal: Prince Ji of Wuling raised troops and marched east down the outer waterways, made Marquis Shouwei of Yifeng Inspector of Yizhou to hold Chengdu, and sent his son Prince Yuansu of Yidu as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Xiao Ji of Wuling raised troops and marched east down the outer waterways, made Marquis Shouwei of Yifeng inspector of Yizhou to hold Chengdu, and sent his son Prince Yuansu of Yidu as deputy.

sentences.zh: 九月，甲戌，司空南平王恪卒。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jiaxu, Minister of Works Prince Ke of Nanping died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiaxu, minister of works Prince Xiao Ke of Nanping died.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以王僧辯為揚州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Wang Senbian was made Inspector of Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Wang Senbian was made inspector of Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 齊主使告王僧辯、陳霸先曰：「請釋廣陵之圍，必歸廣陵、歷陽兩城。

translations.literal: The Qi ruler sent word to Wang Senbian and Chen Baxian: "Please lift the siege of Guangling—we will certainly return Guangling and Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: The Qi ruler sent word to Wang Senbian and Chen Baxian: "Please lift the siege of Guangling—we will certainly return Guangling and Liyang."

sentences.zh: 」霸先引兵還京口，江北之民從霸先濟江者萬餘口。

translations.literal: " Baxian withdrew to Jingkou; more than ten thousand households north of the Yangtze followed Baxian across the river.
translations.idiomatic: " Baxian withdrew to Jingkou; more than ten thousand households north of the Yangtze followed Baxian across the river.

sentences.zh: 湘東王以霸先為征北大將軍、開府儀同三司、南徐州刺史，征霸先世子昌及兄子頊詣江陵，以昌為員外散騎常侍，頊為領直。

translations.literal: The Prince of Xiangdong made Baxian Grand General Who Conquers the North, equal in honor to the three dukes with an open office, and Inspector of Southern Xuzhou; he summoned Baxian's heir Chang and nephew Shuo to Jiangling, making Chang supernumerary cavalier attendant and Shuo commander of the palace guard.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Xiao Yi made Baxian grand general who conquers the north, equal in honor to the three dukes with an open office, and inspector of Southern Xuzhou; he summoned Baxian's heir Chang and nephew Shuo to Jiangling, making Chang supernumerary cavalier attendant and Shuo commander of the palace guard.

sentences.zh: 宜豐侯循之降魏也，丞相泰許其南還，久而未遣，從容問劉璠曰：「我於古誰比？

translations.literal: When Marquis Xun of Yifeng surrendered to Wei, Chancellor Tai had promised he might return south, but long did not send him; at ease he asked Liu Fan, "Whom among the ancients am I like?
translations.idiomatic: When Marquis Xiao Xun of Yifeng surrendered to Western Wei, Chancellor Yuwen Tai had promised he might return south, but long did not send him; at ease he asked Liu Fan, "Whom among the ancients am I like?"

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「璠常以公為湯、武，今日所見，曾桓、文之不如！

translations.literal: " He answered, "Fan always took you for Tang and Wu; what I see today falls short even of Duke Huan and Duke Wen of Jin!
translations.idiomatic: " He answered, "Fan always took you for Tang and Wu; what I see today falls short even of Duke Huan and Duke Wen of Jin!"

sentences.zh: 」泰曰：「我安敢比湯、武，庶幾望伊、周，何至不如桓、文！

translations.literal: " Tai said, "How would I dare compare myself to Tang and Wu? I hoped at most for Yi Yin and the Duke of Zhou—how could I be worse than Huan and Wen!
translations.idiomatic: " Tai said, "How would I dare compare myself to Tang and Wu? I hoped at most for Yi Yin and the Duke of Zhou—how could I be worse than Huan and Wen!"

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「齊桓存三亡國，晉文不失信於伐原。

translations.literal: " He answered, "Duke Huan of Qi preserved three perished states; Duke Wen of Jin did not break faith over the campaign at Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: " He answered, "Duke Huan of Qi preserved three perished states; Duke Wen of Jin did not break faith over the campaign at Yuan."

sentences.zh: 」語未竟，泰撫掌曰：「我解爾意，欲激我耳。

translations.literal: " Before he finished, Tai clapped his hands and said, "I understand your meaning—you mean to stir me.
translations.idiomatic: " Before he finished, Tai clapped his hands and said, "I understand your meaning—you mean to stir me."

sentences.zh: 」乃謂循曰：「王欲之荊，為之益？

translations.literal: " He then said to Xun, "Do you wish to go to Jing? Shall I help you?
translations.idiomatic: " He then said to Xun, "Do you wish to go to Jing? Shall I help you?"

sentences.zh: 」循請還江陵，泰厚禮遣之。

translations.literal: " Xun asked to return to Jiangling; Tai sent him off with generous rites.
translations.idiomatic: " Xun asked to return to Jiangling; Tai sent him off with generous rites.

sentences.zh: 循以文武千家自隨，湘東王疑之，遣使覘察，相望於道；

translations.literal: Xun brought more than a thousand civil and military households with him; the Prince of Xiangdong was suspicious and sent agents to watch, meeting one another all along the road;
translations.idiomatic: Xun brought more than a thousand civil and military households with him; Prince Xiao Yi was suspicious and sent agents to watch, meeting one another all along the road;

sentences.zh: 始至之夕，命劫竊其財，及旦，循啟輸馬仗，王乃安之，引入，對泣，以循為侍中、驃騎將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: on the evening he first arrived, the prince ordered his goods robbed; at dawn Xun reported offering horses and arms, and the prince then was reassured, received him in, wept face to face, and made Xun Attendant-in-Ordinary, Rapid-as-Tiger General, and equal in honor to the three dukes with an open office.
translations.idiomatic: on the evening he first arrived, the prince ordered his goods robbed; at dawn Xun reported offering horses and arms, and the prince then was reassured, received him in, wept face to face, and made Xun attendant-in-ordinary, rapid-as-tiger general, and equal in honor to the three dukes with an open office.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，齊主自晉陽如離石，自黃櫨嶺起長城，北至社平戍，四百餘里，置三十六戍。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, the Qi ruler went from Jinyang to Lishi, raised the Long Wall from Huanglu Ridge north to Sheping Garrison—more than four hundred li—and set thirty-six garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, the Qi ruler went from Jinyang to Lishi, raised the Long Wall from Huanglu Ridge north to Sheping Garrison—more than four hundred li—and set thirty-six garrisons.

sentences.zh: 戊申，湘東王執湘州刺史王琳於殿中，殺其副將殷晏。

translations.literal: On wushen, the Prince of Xiangdong seized Xiangzhou Inspector Wang Lin in the hall and killed his deputy Yin Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Prince Xiao Yi seized Xiangzhou inspector Wang Lin in the hall and killed his deputy Yin Yan.

sentences.zh: 琳本會稽兵家，其姊妹皆入王宮，故琳少在王左右。

translations.literal: Lin came from a military family in Kuaiji; his sisters had all entered the prince's palace, so Lin grew up at the prince's side.
