translations.idiomatic: Lin came from a military family in Kuaiji; his sisters had all entered the prince's palace, so Lin grew up at the prince's side.

sentences.zh: 琳好勇，王以為將帥。

translations.literal: Lin loved valor; the prince made him a commander.
translations.idiomatic: Lin loved valor; the prince made him a commander.

sentences.zh: 琳傾身下士，所得賞賜，不以入家。

translations.literal: Lin poured himself out to honor men below him and did not bring rewards home.
translations.idiomatic: Lin poured himself out to honor men below him and did not bring rewards home.

sentences.zh: 麾下萬人，多江、淮群盜，從王僧辯平侯景，與杜龕功居第一。

translations.literal: Under him were ten thousand men, mostly river-bandits of the Jianghuai; following Wang Senbian he pacified Hou Jing, and with Du Kan his merit ranked first.
translations.idiomatic: Under him were ten thousand men, mostly river-bandits of the Jianghuai; following Wang Senbian he pacified Hou Jing, and with Du Kan his merit ranked first.

sentences.zh: 在建康，恃寵縱暴，僧辯不能禁。

translations.literal: At Jiankang he relied on favor and ran wild; Senbian could not restrain him.
translations.idiomatic: At Jiankang he relied on favor and ran wild; Senbian could not restrain him.

sentences.zh: 僧辯以宮殿之燒，恐得罪，欲以琳塞責，乃密啟王，請誅琳。

translations.literal: Senbian, fearing blame for the burning of the palaces, wished to lay the fault on Lin and secretly reported to the prince, asking that Lin be executed.
translations.idiomatic: Senbian, fearing blame for the burning of the palaces, wished to lay the fault on Lin and secretly reported to the prince, asking that Lin be executed.

sentences.zh: 王以琳為湘州，琳自疑及禍，使長史陸納帥部曲赴湘州，身詣江陵陳謝，謂納等曰：「吾若不返，子將安之？

translations.literal: The prince sent Lin to Xiangzhou; Lin suspected disaster, had Chief Clerk Lu Na lead his household troops to Xiangzhou, and went himself to Jiangling to explain, saying to Na and the rest, "If I do not return, where will you go?
translations.idiomatic: The prince sent Lin to Xiangzhou; Lin suspected disaster, had chief clerk Lu Na lead his household troops to Xiangzhou, and went himself to Jiangling to explain, saying to Na and the rest, "If I do not return, where will you go?"

sentences.zh: 」鹹曰：「請死之。

translations.literal: " All said, "We ask to die with you.
translations.idiomatic: " All said, "We ask to die with you."

sentences.zh: 」相泣而別。

translations.literal: " They wept and parted.
translations.idiomatic: " They wept and parted.

sentences.zh: 至江陵，王下琳吏。

translations.literal: When he reached Jiangling, the prince handed Lin over to the law officers.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached Jiangling, the prince handed Lin over to the law officers.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以王子方略為湘州刺史，又以廷尉黃羅漢為長史，使與太舟卿張載至巴陵，先據琳軍。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Prince Zilüe was made Inspector of Xiangzhou, and Director of Justice Huang Luohan was made chief clerk; they were sent with Grand Master of Boats Zhang Zai to Baling to seize Lin's army first.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Prince Zilüe was made inspector of Xiangzhou, and director of justice Huang Luohan was made chief clerk; they were sent with grand master of boats Zhang Zai to Baling to seize Lin's army first.

sentences.zh: 載有寵於王，而御下峻刻，荊州人疾之如仇。

translations.literal: Zai had the prince's favor but ruled subordinates harshly; the people of Jingzhou hated him as an enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Zai had the prince's favor but ruled subordinates harshly; the people of Jingzhou hated him as an enemy.

sentences.zh: 羅漢等至琳軍，陸納及士卒並哭，不肯受命，執羅漢及載。

translations.literal: When Luohan and the rest reached Lin's army, Lu Na and the soldiers all wept, refused to accept orders, and seized Luohan and Zai.
translations.idiomatic: When Luohan and the rest reached Lin's army, Lu Na and the soldiers all wept, refused to accept orders, and seized Luohan and Zai.

sentences.zh: 王遣宦者陳旻往諭之，納對旻刳載腹，抽腸以繫馬足，使繞而走，腸盡氣絕。

translations.literal: The prince sent eunuch Chen Min to instruct them; Na answered Min by cutting open Zai's belly, drawing out the intestines to tie to a horse's hoof, and making him run in a circle until the guts were gone and breath ended.
translations.idiomatic: The prince sent eunuch Chen Min to instruct them; Na answered Min by cutting open Zai's belly, drawing out the intestines to tie to a horse's hoof, and making him run in a circle until the guts were gone and breath ended.

sentences.zh: 又臠割，出其心，向之抃舞，焚其餘骨。

translations.literal: He then carved the flesh, took out the heart, danced toward it in triumph, and burned the remaining bones.
translations.idiomatic: He then carved the flesh, took out the heart, danced toward it in triumph, and burned the remaining bones.

sentences.zh: 以黃羅漢清謹而免之。

translations.literal: Huang Luohan was spared for his purity and care.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Luohan was spared for his purity and care.

sentences.zh: 納與諸將引兵襲湘州，時州中無主，納遂據之。

translations.literal: Na and the generals led troops to strike Xiangzhou; the province had no leader, and Na seized it.
translations.idiomatic: Na and the generals led troops to strike Xiangzhou; the province had no leader, and Na seized it.

sentences.zh: 公卿籓鎮數勸進於湘東王，十一月，丙子，世祖即皇帝位於江陵，改元，大赦。

translations.literal: High ministers and frontier lords repeatedly urged the Prince of Xiangdong to ascend; in the eleventh month, on bingzi, Shizu took the throne at Jiangling, changed the era name, and proclaimed a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: High ministers and frontier lords repeatedly urged Prince Xiao Yi to ascend; in the eleventh month, on bingzi, Emperor Yuan took the throne at Jiangling, changed the era name, and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 是日，帝不升正殿，公卿陪列而已。

translations.literal: That day the emperor did not ascend the main hall; the ministers stood in attendance only.
translations.idiomatic: That day the emperor did not ascend the main hall; the ministers stood in attendance only.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以宜豐侯循為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Marquis Xun of Yifeng was made Inspector of Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Marquis Xiao Xun of Yifeng was made inspector of Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 己卯，立王太子方矩為皇太子，更名元良。

translations.literal: On jimao, crown prince Fangju was installed as heir apparent and renamed Yuanliang.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, crown prince Fangju was installed as heir apparent and renamed Yuanliang.

sentences.zh: 皇子方智為晉安王，方略為始安王，方等之子莊為永嘉王。

translations.literal: The prince's son Fangzhi was made Prince of Jin'an, Zilüe Prince of Shi'an, and Zhuang son of Fangdeng Prince of Yongjia.
translations.idiomatic: The prince's son Fangzhi was made Prince of Jin'an, Zilüe Prince of Shi'an, and Zhuang son of Fangdeng Prince of Yongjia.

sentences.zh: 追尊母阮修容為文宣皇后。

translations.literal: His mother Lady Ruan Xiurong was posthumously honored as Empress Wenxuan.
translations.idiomatic: His mother Lady Ruan Xiurong was posthumously honored as Empress Wenxuan.

sentences.zh: 侯景之亂，州郡太半入魏，自巴陵以下至建康，以長江為限，荊州界北盡武寧，西拒硤口，嶺南復為蕭勃所據，詔令所行，千里而近，民戶著籍者，不盈三萬而已。

translations.literal: In Hou Jing's rebellion, more than half the provinces and commanderies fell to Wei; from Baling down to Jiankang the Yangtze was the border; Jingzhou's north ran to Wuning and west to Xiakou; Lingnan was again held by Xiao Bo; imperial orders ran only a thousand li or so, and registered households did not exceed thirty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In Hou Jing's rebellion, more than half the provinces and commanderies fell to Western Wei; from Baling down to Jiankang the Yangtze was the border; Jingzhou's north ran to Wuning and west to Xiakou; Lingnan was again held by Xiao Bo; imperial orders ran only a thousand li or so, and registered households did not exceed thirty thousand.

sentences.zh: 陸納襲擊衡州刺史丁道貴於淥口，破之。

translations.literal: Lu Na attacked Hengzhou Inspector Ding Daogui at Lukou and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Na attacked Hengzhou inspector Ding Daogui at Lukou and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 道貴奔零陵，其眾悉降於納。

translations.literal: Daogui fled to Lingling; his troops all surrendered to Na.
translations.idiomatic: Daogui fled to Lingling; his troops all surrendered to Na.

sentences.zh: 上聞之，遣使征司徒王僧辯、右衛將軍杜崱、平北將軍裴之橫與宜豐侯循共討納，循軍巴陵以待之。

translations.literal: When the emperor heard, he sent orders summoning Minister of Education Wang Senbian, Right Guard General Du Ya, and General Who Pacifies the North Pei Zhiheng with Marquis Xun of Yifeng to suppress Na together; Xun encamped at Baling to await them.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor heard, he sent orders summoning minister of education Wang Senbian, right guard general Du Ya, and general who pacifies the north Pei Zhiheng with Marquis Xiao Xun of Yifeng to suppress Na together; Xun encamped at Baling to await them.

sentences.zh: 侯景之亂，零陵人李洪雅據其郡，上即以為營州刺史。

translations.literal: In Hou Jing's rebellion, Li Hongya of Lingling held his commandery; the emperor at once made him Inspector of Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Hou Jing's rebellion, Li Hongya of Lingling held his commandery; the emperor at once made him inspector of Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 洪雅請討陸納，上許之。

translations.literal: Hongya asked to attack Lu Na; the emperor consented.
translations.idiomatic: Hongya asked to attack Lu Na; the emperor consented.

sentences.zh: 丁道貴收餘眾與之俱。

translations.literal: Ding Daogui gathered his remnant and went with him.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Daogui gathered his remnant and went with him.

sentences.zh: 納遣其將吳藏襲擊，破之，洪雅等退保空雲城，藏引兵圍之。

translations.literal: Na sent his general Wu Zang to strike, defeated them, and Hongya and the rest withdrew to hold Kongyun; Zang led troops to besiege it.
translations.idiomatic: Na sent his general Wu Zang to strike, defeated them, and Hongya and the rest withdrew to hold Kongyun; Zang led troops to besiege it.

sentences.zh: 頃之，納請降，求送妻子，上遣陳旻至納所，納眾皆泣，曰：「王郎被囚，故我曹旻逃罪於湘州，非有它志也。

translations.literal: Soon Na asked to surrender and begged to send wife and children; the emperor sent Chen Min to Na's camp; Na's men all wept and said, "Lord Wang is imprisoned—so we came to Xiangzhou only to escape punishment, with no other intent.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Na asked to surrender and begged to send wife and children; the emperor sent Chen Min to Na's camp; Na's men all wept and said, "Lord Wang is imprisoned—we came to Xiangzhou only to escape punishment, with no other intent."

sentences.zh: 」乃出妻子付旻。

translations.literal: " They then sent out wife and children to Min.
translations.idiomatic: " They then sent out wife and children to Min.

sentences.zh: 旻至巴陵，循曰：「此詐也，必將襲我。

translations.literal: When Min reached Baling, Xun said, "This is a trick—they will surely strike us.
translations.idiomatic: When Min reached Baling, Xun said, "This is a trick—they will surely strike us."

sentences.zh: 」乃密為之備。

translations.literal: " He secretly made preparations.
translations.idiomatic: " He secretly made preparations.

sentences.zh: 納果夜以輕兵繼旻後，約至城下鼓噪。

translations.literal: Na indeed sent light troops by night to follow Min, planning to reach the walls and raise a clamor.
translations.idiomatic: Na indeed sent light troops by night to follow Min, planning to reach the walls and raise a clamor.

sentences.zh: 十二月，壬午晨，去巴陵十里，眾謂已至，即鼓噪，軍中皆驚。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the morning of renwu, ten li from Baling, his men thought they had arrived and at once raised a clamor; the whole army was alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the morning of renwu, ten li from Baling, his men thought they had arrived and at once raised a clamor; the whole army was alarmed.

sentences.zh: 循坐胡床，於壘門望之，納乘水來攻，矢下如雨，循方食甘蔗，略無懼色。

translations.literal: Xun sat on a camp stool at the gate of the rampart watching; Na came by water to attack, arrows fell like rain, yet Xun was eating sugarcane with hardly a sign of fear.
translations.idiomatic: Xun sat on a camp stool at the gate of the rampart watching; Na came by water to attack, arrows fell like rain, yet Xun was eating sugarcane with hardly a sign of fear.

sentences.zh: 徐部分將士擊之，獲其一艦。

translations.literal: Leisurely he deployed officers and soldiers to strike and captured one of their ships.
translations.idiomatic: Leisurely he deployed officers and soldiers to strike and captured one of their ships.

sentences.zh: 納退保長沙。

translations.literal: Na withdrew to hold Changsha.
translations.idiomatic: Na withdrew to hold Changsha.

sentences.zh: 壬午，齊主還鄴；

translations.literal: On renwu, the Qi ruler returned to Ye;
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, the Qi ruler returned to Ye;

sentences.zh: 戊午，復如晉陽。

translations.literal: on wuwu, he went again to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: on wuwu, he went again to Jinyang.

translations.idiomatic: category: Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance
